title: Courtyard’s Sports GOAT Pack: Chase Jordan, Brady, Gretzky & Mays
summary: Celebrate the Sports Equinox with Courtyard's Sports GOAT Pack ($189). Chase PSA-graded grails from Wayne Gretzky, Tom Brady, Michael Jordan, and Willie Mays.
body_markdown:
Who is the real Greatest Of All Time?


That debate has raged since…well, forever…and doesn’t appear to be ending anytime down soon. Is it His Airness,[Michael Jordan](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Michael%20Jordan&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ? Is[hockey](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=hockey) the hardest sport of all, making[Wayne Gretzky](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Wayne%20Gretzky&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’s mind-boggling stats the highest bar to achieve? Can anyone top[Tom Brady](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tom%20Brady&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’s seven Super Bowl rings? How about[Willie Mays](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Willie%20Mays&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ’ 24 All-Star appearances?


While Courtyard can’t settle the argument, we can make our picks for the best to ever do it—and give sports card collectors a chance to chase them. The moment is finally here:[The Sports GOAT Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine) ($189) is back on Courtyard!


## **Chase Wayne Gretzky, Tom Brady, Michael Jordan, and Willie Mays Cards**


On Monday, October 26th, the Sports Equinox returns; all four of the North American big four professional sports have games on the same day. Good luck doing anything but watching ball!


To celebrate, Courtyard has restocked its famed Sports GOAT Pack with PSA-graded chase cards from Michael Jordan, Tom Brady, Wayne Gretzky, and Willie Mays, which fans can chase through November 5th.


### **2009 Upper Deck Now Appearing #NA-6**[Michael Jordan](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Michael%20Jordan&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 9 MINT)**


Collectors commonly call this Upper Deck Now Appearing insert the “Scarface” card thanks to the black-and-white photo of Jordan hunched-over, hearkening back to the movie’s key art featuring none other than Tony Montana. “[Say hello to my little friend!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AVQ8byG2mY8) ”


### **2000 Fleer #352**[Tom Brady](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tom%20Brady&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **/Dave Stachelski Rookie Card (PSA 10 GEM MINT)**


This is a Tom Brady rookie card. Enough said. Sharing space with Dave Stachelski via Fleer’s Rookies to Watch subset, the card was printed before Brady won seven Super Bowls, the most of any player in NFL history. PSA has graded roughly 3,500 copies of this card, and only a small share earned the coveted PSA 10. This card is one of them.


### **1979 O-Pee-Chee #18**[Wayne Gretzky](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Wayne%20Gretzky&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **Rookie Card(PSA 5 EX)**


Another rookie card, and from the highly praised O-Pee-Chee print, no less. A PSA 10 of this card became[the first hockey card to sell for more than $1 million](https://www.nbcsports.com/nhl/news/wayne-gretzky-rookie-card-sets-record-with-1-3m-sale-at-auction) when it went for $1.29 million at Heritage Auctions in 2020, and[another PSA 10 sold for $3.75 million in 2021](https://www.cbc.ca/sports/hockey/nhl/wayne-gretzky-rookie-card-sells-for-record-price-1.6043194) . A PSA 5 is a far more accessible—albeit grail-worthy—way to own the most important card in hockey.


### **1952 Topps #261**[Willie Mays](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Willie%20Mays&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **(PSA 1 PR)**


This is Mays’ first Topps card (his rookie card is from 1951 Bowman), and it comes from Topps’ first flagship release—a cornerstone of the postwar hobby. Released 74 years ago, the card isn’t easy to come by, and this PSA 1 is a rare chance to own a piece of the set.


The lineup of GOATs spans more than seven decades, from the 1952 Topps Mays to 2009’s Upper Deck Jordan, and features two of the superstars in their rookie year. Worried about the authenticity of vintage cards?[Every collectible on Courtyard is both authenticated and graded](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/welcome-to-card-school-the-difference-between-slabbed-cards-and-their-raw-counterparts) , giving you peace of mind as you chase everything from[sneakers](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/inside-courtyards-sneaker-packs-grails-lore-the-sneaker-reset?d565656f_page=1) and[comic books](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=comics) to[modern NBA grail cards](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=basketball) .


## **The GOAT Debate: Top 10 Most-Searched Athletes on Courtyard**

1. [Michael Jordan](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Michael%20Jordan&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
2. [Shohei Ohtani](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shohei%20Ohtani&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
3. [Kobe Bryant](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Kobe%20Bryant&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
4. [LeBron James](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=LeBron%20James&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
5. [Lionel Messi](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Lionel%20Messi&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
6. [Tom Brady](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tom%20Brady&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
7. [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Cristiano%20Ronaldo&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
8. [Wayne Gretzky](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Wayne%20Gretzky&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
9. [Jerry Rice](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jerry%20Rice&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low)
10. [Willie Mays](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Willie%20Mays&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ‍


Apparently basketball reigns supreme, as do more modern greats across all sports. Respect your elders, people! And the sport of hockey, too. (Canadian icon[Connor McDavid](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Connor%20McDavid&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) came in at #11, just outside of the top-10). Meanwhile, soccer gets some serious love. Maybe it’s the fact that it’s the global game, or the recent World Cup boost.


## **How to Chase Sports GOAT Packs on Courtyard**


Whether you’re a[basketball](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=basketball) fan that has rewatched[The Last Dance](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt8420184/) ** more times than you can count, or a[baseball](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=baseball) fan that can recount the Say Hey Kid’s stats by heart, Courtyard’s got the chase cards to help you settle the GOAT debate once and for all.


From today through November 5th, find grails from Michael Jordan, Tom Brady, Wayne Gretzky and Willie Mays in our[Sports GOAT Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop) ($189)—all of which are graded and authenticated so you don’t have to worry about PSA wait times (or bent corners).
